datasheet_identity.title: US1AW THRU US1MW SURFACE MOUNT HIGH EFFICIENT RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: Page 1 identifies US1MW as the 1000 V variant: VRRM = 1000 V and VDC = 1000 V; IF(AV) = 1.0 A and IFSM = 30 A.

Page 2 Fig. 3 was digitized from the dotted US1JW-US1MW typical forward-voltage curve. The current axis is logarithmic and the curve is specified for Tj = 25 degC, 300 us pulse width, and 1% duty cycle.

Page 2 Fig. 4 was digitized for both Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 125 degC. Its x-axis is percent of rated peak reverse voltage, so those curve x-values are retained as percentages rather than converted to absolute voltage.

The table gives US1MW maximum VF = 1.7 V at IF = 1.0 A, maximum Trr = 75 ns, maximum IR1 = 2.0 uA at rated DC blocking voltage and TA = 25 degC, maximum IR2 = 200 uA at TA = 125 degC, and typical CJ = 9.0 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz.

Breakdown voltage and breakdown current are omitted because the datasheet supplies reverse-voltage ratings and leakage characteristics, not a breakdown test point; VRRM/VDC was not treated as breakdown evidence.
